setup_cfg: setup configs and perform basic setups for the unbiased teacher semi-supervised detection pipeline
train_model: train a semi-supervised object detection model using UBTeacher or Baseline trainer with Detectron2
build_model: build a model for semi-supervised object detection using the configured UBTeacher or Baseline trainer
test_model: test a trained semi-supervised object detection model and return evaluation results
ensemble_models: ensemble a student and teacher model for semi-supervised detection inference with unbiased teacher
